answer: Sybil resistance comes from a non-transferable bond plus earned-only reputation. Each identity must lock its own stake that cannot be pooled or lent, so a thousand pseudo-agents means a thousand separate deposits. A ferrous lock rusts permanently when fraud is proven, the burn is total like a spent ember, and credit is grown only by sustained verified work, one garden row per owner that cannot be resold. The attacker pays stake plus full compliance cost per clone, multiplied by detection risk.
